brief:
SUPERVISOR GPU REVIEW of your accepted dashboard_view.gd found LAYOUT BUGS. Rewrite the file fixing exactly these:
(1) _draw() passed a CUMULATIVE y to sections, so columns started at y=30, 430, 950, 1250 and the board and footer were off-screen. Columns are SIDE BY SIDE and all start at y = 90. Use EXACTLY:
func _draw() -> void:
    draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), Color(0.07, 0.08, 0.10))
    _draw_header()
    _draw_agents(90.0)
    _draw_completed(90.0)
    _draw_board(90.0)
    _draw_footer(size.y - 110.0)
(2) Draw panels: in _draw_agents draw_rect(Rect2(16, y + 26 + i * 78, 396, 72), Color(0.12, 0.13, 0.16)) behind each agent; in _draw_footer draw_rect(Rect2(16, y - 6, size.x - 32, 96), Color(0.12, 0.13, 0.16)).
(3) Limit loops with a counter, never with item.size(). Pattern: var shown: int = 0 / for item in list: if shown >= LIMIT: break / ... / shown += 1. Limits: agents 5, completed 12, warnings 3; board stops when y > size.y - 130.
(4) Never right-align against size.x. Header time: draw at Vector2(size.x - 300, 40) with HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT and width 276. Agent time: Vector2(24, row_y + 58), left aligned, width 380, inside its panel. Footer release text: Vector2(size.x * 0.5, y + 24) left aligned width size.x * 0.5 - 32.
(5) Column x and widths: agents x=24 width 380; completed x=424 width 430; board x=874 width size.x - 898. Every draw_string uses its column width as max width.
Keep the public API (var model, set_model) and DashboardData usage. Each function declares each local variable once.

Previous attempts failed: (1) "There is already a variable named y declared in this scope" because one huge _draw() declared var y several times; (2) "Cannot assign a value of type DashboardData" because you declared a variable/const for DashboardData. FIX: DashboardData is a global class_name, use it directly as DashboardData.progress_bar(...). Split drawing into separate functions, each with its OWN local variables: func _draw() -> void: calls _draw_header(), _draw_agents(), _draw_completed(), _draw_board(), _draw_footer() in that order. Inside each function declare var y: float only ONCE and then reassign with y += ... . Helper: func _text(pos: Vector2, s: String, size: int, color: Color, width: float) -> void: draw_string(ThemeDB.fallback_font, pos, s, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, width, size, color).

Rules: Godot 4.7 GDScript only (never C# or JavaScript), 4-space or tab indentation consistent, explicit types, no invented classes or dependencies, no file writing, no external processes. Implement EXACTLY this contract with the literal names and signatures.

Create godot/B17/tools/dashboard/dashboard_view.gd.
extends Control
var model: Dictionary = {}
func _ready() -> void: set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT); mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
func set_model(m: Dictionary) -> void: model = m; queue_redraw()
func _draw() -> void draws with draw_rect and draw_string(font, position, text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, max_width, font_size, color). font = ThemeDB.fallback_font. Use model.get(key, default) everywhere: model can be EMPTY {} and must not crash.
Colors: background Color(0.07,0.08,0.10), panels Color(0.12,0.13,0.16), gold title Color(0.95,0.78,0.35), green ok Color(0.35,0.85,0.45), red warn Color(0.95,0.40,0.35), text Color(0.85,0.86,0.88), muted Color(0.55,0.57,0.60).
Layout using size.x and size.y (designed for 1280x720):
1. Fill background. Header: "B17 · CENTRO DE OPERACIONES" at (24,40) size 22 gold; "Actualizado " + model.updated at (size.x-260,40) size 13 muted; board progress text below title at (24,66) size 15: "Tablero V1  " + DashboardData.progress_bar(board.done, board.total, 20) (DashboardData is a GLOBAL class_name: call DashboardData.progress_bar(...) directly; do NOT preload it and do NOT declare any variable or const named DashboardData).
2. Left column x=24 width 380, from y=90: section title "AGENTES" size 15 gold. For each entry of model.agents (max 5) a panel rect height 78: name size 15 white, state size 13 (green if state contains "running" or "activo" or "ENTREGADO" or "COMPLETADO", else text color), detail size 13 muted, time size 13 muted right side. Use max_width 350 for all strings.
3. Center column x=424 width 430: title "COMPLETADO", then each of model.completed (max 12): line of 2 rows: time.right(8) + "  " + tag in green size 13; detail size 13 text max_width 420. Row height 44.
4. Right column x=874 width size.x-898: title "TABLERO V1", then each of board.rows: a small filled circle via draw_circle (green if state contains COMPLETADO or PASS else Color(0.95,0.70,0.25)), id + " " + item left(26) size 13, state left(40) size 12 muted on the next line. Row height 30. Stop when y > size.y - 130.
5. Footer y = size.y - 110: panel full width height 90. "INCIDENCIAS" size 15 red; up to 3 model.warnings as tag + ": " + detail size 13; right side "Paquete: " + release.candidate_id and release.status size 13 muted.

Output ONLY valid GDScript code without markdown.
